Duration: 12 months

Report To: Project Coordinator

Organization: New Millennium Women Empowerment Organization (NMWEO)

Organizational Profile
1.1 General Information

New Millennium Women Empowerment Organization (NMWEO) is an indigenous, non-governmental, non-profit humanitarian organization established in 2007 in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. The organization was previously registered at the Ministry of Justice under registration number 3018 and later registered and licensed by the Federal Charities and Societies Agency as an Ethiopian resident’s charity by the Charities and Societal Proclamation No. 621/2009 by registration No. 0539. NMWEO has been re-registered according to the Civil Society Organizations Proclamation No.113/2019 with registration No. 0539.

Vision 

We envision a country in which women and girls have equal opportunity, claim their rights and free from any violence, and become effective social change agents.

Mission

Our mission is to empower Ethiopian women, girls, and youth in economic, political, and social dimensions, and help them unlock their potential in decision-making through capacity building, advocacy, leadership development, and humanitarian intervention programs.

Core Values and Belief

·       Humanity

·       Gender sensitive

·       Accountability

·       Equity

·       Teamwork and Excellence

·       Partnership and networking

Job Purpose

The Protection Officer is responsible for the planning, coordination, implementation, monitoring, and reporting of protection activities at woreda level. The Officer will lead the implementation of community-based protection interventions, strengthen community protection committees, facilitate consultations on child and early marriage, support the implementation of community action plans, and oversee the rehabilitation and functioning of the existing Women and Girls Safe Space (WGSS), where applicable.

The Protection Officer will work closely with the Social Worker, community structures, religious leaders, local authorities, and relevant service providers to ensure that protection activities are inclusive, community-led, safe, accountable, and consistent with protection, safeguarding, PSEA, child protection, gender, disability inclusion, and Do No Harm principles.

Key Responsibilities

A.   Protection Programme Coordination

  • Lead the day-to-day implementation of protection activities in the assigned woreda.
  • Translate project plans and objectives into practical woreda-level implementation plans.
  • Ensure activities are implemented according to approved plans, budgets, quality standards, and timelines.
  • Coordinate closely with the Project Coordinator on progress, priorities, challenges, and required actions.
  • Provide technical supervision and guidance to the Social Worker.
  • Maintain effective coordination with relevant government offices, community structures, religious leaders, and other stakeholders.
  • Represent the project in relevant woreda-level coordination forums and meetings.
  • Identify protection risks, operational challenges, and emerging needs and recommend appropriate responses.

B.   Community-Based Protection and Stakeholder Engagement

  • Strengthen community ownership and participation in protection programming.
  • Support the establishment, capacity, functionality, and sustainability of community-based protection mechanisms.
  • Facilitate meaningful engagement of community leaders, religious leaders, local authorities, women, youth, persons with disabilities, and other relevant groups.
  • Promote community-led identification and prioritization of protection concerns and solutions.
  • Strengthen collaboration between community structures and formal protection and social service systems.
  • Promote locally appropriate prevention and response mechanisms for protection concerns.

C.   Protection Risk Identification and Referral

  • Monitor protection risks and trends within the assigned woreda.
  • Ensure appropriate identification and referral of individuals requiring specialized protection and other essential services.
  • Maintain knowledge of available services and functional referral pathways.
  • Promote safe, confidential, informed, and survivor-/person-centered referral practices.
  • Coordinate with relevant service providers and government structures to strengthen access to services.
  • Ensure urgent protection concerns are appropriately escalated through established mechanisms.

D.   Community Engagement and Prevention

  • Lead community engagement approaches aimed at preventing protection risks and harmful practices.
  • Facilitate dialogue and collaboration among communities, leaders, authorities, and service providers.
  • Promote positive social and behavioral change related to protection, safety, dignity, and rights.
  • Support communities to develop and implement locally owned solutions to identified protection concerns.
  • Ensure community engagement approaches are conflict-sensitive, inclusive, and culturally appropriate.

E.   Women and Girls Safe Space Oversight

  • Provide technical oversight to ensure the existing WGSS is safe, accessible, functional, and responsive to the needs of women and girls.
  • Ensure appropriate linkages between WGSS services and relevant protection, health, psychosocial, legal, and other services.
  • Monitor the quality and accessibility of services provided through the WGSS.
  • Promote confidentiality, dignity, safety, and informed choice for women and girls accessing services.
  • Coordinate with relevant stakeholders to address operational and protection concerns affecting the WGSS.

F.    Monitoring, Quality Assurance and Reporting

  • Monitor implementation against project objectives, indicators, targets, and quality standards.
  • Ensure accurate and timely collection and documentation of project information.
  • Work closely with MEAL staff on monitoring, data quality, accountability, feedback, and learning.
  • Prepare regular activity and progress reports for the Project Coordinator.
  • Document lessons learned, good practices, challenges, and recommendations.
  • Ensure protection information is managed securely and confidentially.

G.  Safeguarding, Inclusion and Accountability

  • Ensure compliance with organizational policies and humanitarian protection standards.
  • Promote gender equality, disability inclusion, child safeguarding, and meaningful participation of vulnerable groups.
  • Ensure activities do not expose beneficiaries or communities to additional risks.
  • Promote awareness and use of feedback, complaint, and reporting mechanisms.
  • Maintain professional boundaries and confidentiality.
  • Immediately report safeguarding, PSEA, and serious protection concerns through established organizational procedures.

H.  Financial and Resource Management

  • Support efficient use of project resources at woreda level.
  • Ensure activities are implemented within approved budgets and procedures.
  • Provide timely information on resource requirements and operational gaps.
  • Support proper documentation and accountability for project resources.

company.name: Ahadu Bank S.C
company.description:
Why work for us?


By joining us, you'll help empower Ethiopians through our pioneering cutting-edge financial services. Join our passionate team, driven by purpose, integrity, and a desire to make a real difference. We offer a dynamic environment, opportunities for growth, and the chance to be part of something revolutionary. Embrace your purpose and build a fulfilling career. This is your chance to shape the future of Ethiopian finance.


Employee Benefits

  • Competitive salary and benefits package
  • Medical Coverage
  • Salary Advance Loan
  • Consumer Loan
  • Mortgage and Vehicle Acquisition Loan.



The Company

Established by visionary entrepreneurs and professionals, Ahadu Bank provides a different model of banking centered on the philosophy of Inclusive Intermediation.

Founded by over 10,000 shareholders and incorporated under the Ethiopian Banking Business Proclamation, Ahadu Bank offers full-fledged commercial banking services. The Bank is domiciled in Ethiopia with its Head Office located on Africa Avenue, Sunshine Building, Addis Ababa.

Ahadu Bank completed the National Bank of Ethiopia's (NBE) initial capital requirement on January 2, 2021, and received its banking license on October 5, 2021. On June 29, 2022, the bank received authorization from the NBE to begin operations and officially opened its doors on July 16, 2022.

According to a June 2024 report, the bank now boasts over 100 branches and a workforce exceeding 900 employees nationwide.


Mission

Pioneer avant-garde financial services for promoting the economic welfare of Ethiopians.


Vision

Take a lead role in the financial sector, in 2025 E.C, in support of the aspirations of the citizenry and the country.


Core values

  1. Fear of God
  2. Passion for Serving
  3. Honesty
  4. Organizational Learning
  5. Proactive Accountability
  6. Humaneness


Our way

We strive to drive the development of Ethiopia's financial services to benefit Ethiopians in a sustainable and inclusive way. We strive to have a positive socio-economic impact in every aspect of our business. We believe that addressing the needs of the unbanked and underbanked by reaching out to rural communities, supporting and nurturing small businesses, practicing responsible banking principles, and investing in innovative technology to digitize our operations helps us create value for our customers, shareholders, and the broader community.


Culture

At Ahadu Bank, our culture thrives on a unique blend of purpose and progress. We're driven by a deep desire to make a positive impact, evident in our core values of social responsibility and financial empowerment for all Ethiopians. We're a passionate team, working together to pioneer cutting-edge financial solutions. Our commitment to innovation goes hand-in-hand with integrity, ensuring we operate with honesty and ethical practices. We believe in fostering a growth mindset, embracing "Organizational Learning" to continuously develop ourselves and each other. This collaborative spirit is core to our success, as we build a supportive and dynamic environment where everyone can thrive. If you're looking to make a real difference and be part of something revolutionary, Ahadu Bank is the place for you.

Why Join JaRco? At JaRco Consulting, you will contribute to evidence-based programs that improves lives. Position Overview JaRco Consulting is seeking a highly motivated and solutions-oriented Area Coordinator to lead and support the effective implementation of Third Party Monitoring (TPM) Activities. This strategic position plays a central role in aligning local activities with national program objectives, ensuring operational excellence, and fostering strong relationships with key regional stakeholders. The Area Coordinator for TPM activities plays a critical role in supporting the effective implementation, coordination, and monitoring of program activities within the respective assigned region. The role ensures seamless coordination between field monitors, superviors, implementing stakeholders, and central management, while also supporting administrative, logistical, operational, and data management functions. The Areas Coordinator ensures that program delivery is timely, efficient, and in line with donor and organizational requirements. This role also requires active engagement with government agencies, WFP regional and suboffices and program participants resolve challenges, and strengthen regional collaboration. Track program deliverables and ensure that field activities comply with project plans and donor guidelines. Provide comprehensive operational and administrative support to supervisors and field monitors, including logistics, supplies, and coordination needs. Coordinate logistical arrangements for field missions, regional meetings, training workshops, and review sessions. Ensure the availability of necessary materials and tools for data collection and monitoring at the regional level. Manage and maintain accurate data entry for regional program activities, ensuring data integrity, security, and confidentiality. Prepare and submit periodic performance reports, summarizing key monitoring findings, challenges, and lessons learned. Maintain an organized and accessible filing system for all regional program documents including reports, field notes, photos, and attendance records. Serve as the primary regional liaison with stakeholders including local government officials, WFP focal points, and community representatives. Respond to inquiries from stakeholders in a timely and professional manner, resolving issues or escalating as needed. Promote collaboration and trust between field teams, local authorities, and program beneficiaries. Assist in the preparation of regional-level budgets and financial forecasts based on planned activities and logistical requirements. Track expenditures related to field operations and ensure compliance with approved budgets and financial procedures. Monitor field activity implementation and flag delays or challenges to the TPM Team Lead. Conduct regular field visits to supervise monitors, assess the quality of data collected, and ensure adherence to ethical and methodological standards. Support quality assurance mechanisms during field data collection, including spot-checks, back-checks, and observation.

fields.title: Packer Machine Operator
fields.description: Position Title: Packer Machine Operator Job Purpose To operate, monitor, and control the packer machine safely and efficiently to ensure the proper packing of finished beverage products according to production plans, quality standards, and packaging specifications. The position is responsible for machine setup, adjustment, basic troubleshooting, routine inspection, cleaning, and maintaining smooth and efficient packaging operations. Key Duties and Responsibilities Operate and monitor the packer machine in accordance with approved operating procedures and production schedules. Set up, adjust, and operate the packing equipment according to product type, packaging format, and production requirements. Ensure proper feeding, grouping, packing, and discharge of finished beverage products. Monitor the quality and integrity of packed products, packaging materials, cartons, trays, shrink film, and other packing materials as applicable. Ensure proper arrangement, alignment, counting, and packing of bottles/cans according to the specified packaging configuration. Conduct routine inspections of the packer machine and identify abnormal operating conditions, mechanical problems, product jams, and other malfunctions. Perform basic machine adjustments and troubleshooting to minimize downtime and maintain continuous production. Monitor machine operating parameters and ensure that the machine operates within established specifications. Ensure proper synchronization of the packer machine with conveyors, filler, labeller, shrink-wrapper, palletizer, and other associated packaging equipment as applicable. Check the availability and proper supply of packaging materials required for continuous operation. Identify and remove damaged, improperly packed, misaligned, or non-conforming products from the production line. Maintain accurate records of production output, machine stoppages, downtime, rejects, wastage, and packaging material consumption. Report machine breakdowns, quality deviations, material shortages, safety hazards, and abnormal operating conditions promptly to the supervisor or maintenance team. Work closely with maintenance personnel during preventive maintenance, corrective maintenance, machine inspection, and breakdown recovery. Carry out routine cleaning, sanitation, lubrication, and operator-level maintenance activities in accordance with approved procedures. Maintain proper housekeeping and 5S standards around the machine and packaging area. Ensure compliance with GMP, food safety, quality, occupational health and safety, environmental, and company requirements. Monitor and minimize product damage, packaging material wastage, and production losses. Follow approved procedures for machine start-up, operation, changeover, shutdown, and emergency stopping. Ensure that machine guards, interlocks, emergency stops, and other safety devices are properly installed and functional. Immediately stop the machine and report unsafe conditions that may cause injury, equipment damage, product contamination, or significant product loss. Participate in machine changeovers and adjustments according to the production plan. Monitor packaging quality to ensure that finished products meet established company standards and customer requirements. Participate in continuous improvement activities aimed at reducing downtime, waste, defects, and packaging costs. Follow all work instructions, standard operating procedures, GMP, HACCP/food safety, and other applicable management-system requirements. Perform other related duties assigned by the immediate supervisor.

fields.description: Job Opening: Fleet Supervisor – Miawa Water Distribution Location: Ethiopia, Oromia Region, Sheger City, Ashewa Mada or Furi Job Type: Full-Time Department: Operations & Logistics Reports To: Operations Manager Job Summary We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented Fleet Supervisor to oversee our daily delivery van operations. In this role, you will be responsible for monitoring driver movements, maintaining complete operational and service histories for all delivery vans, enforcing routine preventive maintenance, and managing relationships with external garage service providers. The ideal candidate has strong supervisory skills, basic mechanical knowledge, and hands-on experience managing light commercial vehicle fleets in a fast-paced distribution environment. Driver Movement & Route Supervision: Track and monitor daily driver movements, route compliance, and delivery schedules using GPS tracking systems and daily trip logs. Oversee driver attendance, dispatch, daily vehicle check-outs/check-ins, and adherence to safe driving practices. Address route delays, vehicle breakdowns, or driver issues in real time to minimize disruption to delivery operations. Fleet Records & Van History Maintenance: Maintain comprehensive, up-to-date physical and digital logs for each delivery van (including mileage, fuel consumption, accident records, insurance, and licensing). Document every repair, part replacement, and service event to build an accurate lifespan and cost history for each vehicle. Routine Maintenance & Service Following: Develop and enforce a systematic preventive maintenance schedule for all vans based on mileage, operational hours, and manufacturer guidelines. Conduct routine physical inspections of delivery vans to check oil levels, tire conditions, brakes, lights, and overall cleanliness before vehicles hit the road. Garage & Service Provider Follow-Up: Serve as the primary point of contact for external garages, workshops, and spare parts suppliers. Authorize, track, and follow up on off-site repairs to ensure quick turnaround times and minimize fleet downtime. Inspect completed repair work at third-party garages to verify quality standards before accepting vehicles back into service. Review garage job cards, repair estimates, and invoices for cost accuracy before submitting them to finance for payment. Incident & Safety Management: Investigate vehicle accidents, damage incidents, or mechanical failures; prepare formal incident reports and coordinate insurance claims. Ensure all vehicles remain fully compliant with safety standards, traffic regulations, and government licensing requirements.

fields.title: Pulmonologist
fields.description: Job Title: Pulmonologist Location: Silk Road Hospital Date: August 8th, 2026 Employment Type: Part time Job Summary A Pulmonologist is a physician who specializes in diagnosing, treating, and managing diseases and disorders of the respiratory system, including the lungs, airways, and related organs. They evaluate patients with acute and chronic respiratory conditions, develop individualized treatment plans, interpret diagnostic tests, and provide ongoing care to improve respiratory health and quality of life. Pulmonologists collaborate with multidisciplinary healthcare teams to deliver evidence-based care, educate patients on disease prevention and management, and participate in quality improvement initiatives while maintaining accurate medical documentation and adhering to clinical and ethical standards. Duties & Responsibilities Diagnose, treat, and manage acute and chronic respiratory diseases, including asthma, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), pneumonia, tuberculosis, interstitial lung disease, pulmonary fibrosis, pulmonary hypertension, and lung cancer. Evaluate patients through comprehensive medical histories, physical examinations, and assessment of respiratory symptoms. Order, interpret, and correlate diagnostic tests such as chest X-rays, CT scans, pulmonary function tests (PFTs), arterial blood gases (ABGs), bronchoscopy findings, sleep studies, and laboratory investigations. Develop and implement individualized treatment plans based on evidence-based clinical guidelines. Prescribe and monitor medications, including bronchodilators, corticosteroids, antibiotics, immunotherapies, and oxygen therapy. Perform and interpret bronchoscopy and other pulmonary procedures, including bronchoalveolar lavage, transbronchial biopsy, and pleural procedures, where credentialed. Diagnose and manage patients requiring non-invasive and invasive mechanical ventilation in intensive care or high-dependency settings. Evaluate and manage patients with sleep-related breathing disorders, including obstructive sleep apnea, when applicable. Provide preoperative pulmonary evaluation and optimize respiratory status before surgery. Manage respiratory emergencies such as acute respiratory failure, severe asthma exacerbations, pulmonary embolism, and pneumothorax. Monitor patient progress, adjust treatment plans, and coordinate follow-up care. Educate patients and their families on disease prevention, smoking cessation, inhaler techniques, pulmonary rehabilitation, and long-term disease management. Collaborate with primary care physicians, intensivists, thoracic surgeons, oncologists, infectious disease specialists, respiratory therapists, nurses, radiologists, and other healthcare professionals to ensure coordinated patient care. Refer patients to appropriate specialists or rehabilitation services when necessary. Maintain accurate, timely, and complete medical records in accordance with hospital policies and regulatory requirements. Participate in multidisciplinary team meetings, case discussions, morbidity and mortality reviews, and quality improvement initiatives. Ensure compliance with infection prevention and control policies, patient safety standards, and ethical and professional guidelines. Supervise and mentor junior physicians, residents, interns, and other clinical staff as assigned. Participate in continuing medical education (CME), clinical research, and professional development activities to maintain competency and stay current with advances in pulmonary medicine. Participate in hospital on-call rotations and provide emergency pulmonary consultations as required. Perform any other duties assigned within the scope of practice and professional competence.

Position: Sales and Marketing Manager

Company: Marta Food Complex

Working Place: Bahir Dar

Salary: Based on company scale (Very attractive plus commission)

Specific Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Plan, organize, direct, coordinate, and control marketing and sales activities, including sales, market research, business development, public relations, advertising, and customer service, as per the required plan and set targets.
  • Coordinate the formulation of plan objectives, development of conceptual frameworks, guidelines, and implementation strategies for the department.
  • Identify new lines of business or expansion of existing sales; prepare reports indicating a range of business alternatives ranked by desirability and probability of success in terms of cost, profit, effectiveness, and risk.
  • Propose strategies to handle future situations affecting business development and sales expansion.
  • Analyze sales data and investment opportunities.
  • Develop and formulate company goals, objectives, and standards.
  • Closely follow actual achievements, compare them with goals, standards, and past performance, and submit performance analyses with appropriate proposals and recommendations to the supervisor.
  • Develop performance indicators, evaluation methods, and review techniques to monitor department staff performance.
  • Conduct gap analyses comparing planned vs. actual sales results and submit findings with recommendations.
  • Develop strategies to ensure business growth and profitability; coordinate studies related to investment and the expansion of products and services.
  • Investigate and evaluate opportunities, providing advice based on competitor performance and market changes.
  • Identify, analyze, and exploit market opportunities to fulfill company strategic objectives.
  • Develop marketing and customer service strategies, designing sales management support systems.
  • Ensure customers are well-treated and their inquiries are addressed in a timely, professional manner.
  • Investigate irregularities in customer service provision and determine corrective measures.
  • Utilize various media channels to promote product features and create awareness for new and existing products.
  • Ensure company services and facilities are marketed according to rules and procedures to satisfy customers.
  • Regularly assess and evaluate product and service quality, contacting suppliers when customer issues arise.
  • Establish a customer-friendly environment and system to enhance business image and stimulate purchases.
  • Interpret, implement, and enforce company marketing and sales policies.
  • Compile and produce weekly, monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, and annual reports on marketing and sales performance for the immediate supervisor.
  • Perform other related duties as required.

company.name: Solidarités International
company.description:
Who are we ?

The NGO Solidarités International assists populations affected by conflicts and violence, epidemics, natural or climate-related disasters and economic collapse. Our humanitarian teams are committed to helping people whose lives, health and security are threatened, by meeting their most vital needs: food, water, shelter and hygiene. Our mandate is to respond to crises by distributing emergency aid in person and, in parallel, by implementing long-term solutions that enable affected populations to regain sustainable access to water, sanitation, hygiene, diversified livelihoods and safe housing.

Solidarités International is registered in Ethiopia in December 2022 and is aiming at developing emergency programs in true collaboration with the beneficiary communities and local stakeholders.

Our mandate and value

Solidarités International commitment to assist populations affected by the most severe crises dates back to 1980. We always provide aid at the request of the affected population or its representatives, in cooperation with our local partners. Our field teams mainly comprise locally hired staff, to help ensure that the aid provided fits the population’s needs as closely as possible. We are fiercely determined to constantly uphold the humanitarian principles of humanity, independence, impartiality and neutrality. Solidarités International also demonstrates unique technical and social engineering capabilities, which we continue to perfect by building on the innovations and development efforts of our teams and partners.

Find out more about our history explained here.

Why work for us ?

In 2022, our 2,641 staff members worked relentlessly to achieve our collective goal: to provide assistance for people affected by conflicts, violence, epidemics, natural and climate-related disasters and economic collapse in the countries where we work.

As part of its global strategy, Solidarités International is committed to

  • Further develop the professionalism of its human resources;
  • Support and value the diversity of our staff and their experience;
  • Set up conditions that fosters our team’s commitment.

Our teams have always been our NGO’s greatest strength. They share the values that guide our humanitarian action and enable our organization to fulfil its mandate: courage, integrity, professionalism, team spirit and unfailing commitment.

Working conditions

In Solidarités International, we prioritize not only making a meaningful impact in the world but also in your career. Joining our team means:

  • Competitive Compensation: we offer competitive compensation packages firmly rooted in the local job market, ensuring fair compensation.
  • Advanced Social Support: Our benefits include health coverage, maternity and paternity leave and a range of other benefits.
  • Career Advancement: Experience real growth opportunities within our organization.
  • Inclusivity and Fairness: We nurture a culture that values equality, transparency, and the recognition of individual contributions.
  • Transparent HR Policies: Our open HR management policies ensure each decisions’ are justified and communicated to all.
  • Safe Work Environment: Our staff’s security is our prime concern.
  • Zero Tolerance for SEAH: We maintain a strict stance against any type of abuse – all act of exploitation, abuse and/or sexual harassment (SEAH).

In Solidarités International, we're committed to improving the world and providing a fulfilling and evolving career for our dedicated team." You are neither anonymous nor interchangeable: neither is Solidarités International!

Solidarités International is an equitable employer committed to find all forms of discrimination. SI will ever ask for any remuneration to take part in a recruitment process.

fields.title: Protection Officer
fields.description: Medical Teams Calling Daring to love like Jesus, we boldly break barriers to health and restore wholeness in a hurting world. Medical Teams International holds strict child and vulnerable adult safeguarding principles and a zero-tolerance policy for misconduct related to sexual harassment, exploitation and abuse in the workplace and other places where the organization’s activities are rendered. Parallel to technical competence, recruitment & selection, hiring decisions will give due emphasis to assessing candidates' eligibility thorough background checks, police clearance, and professional reference check processes. JOB SUMMARY Protection Officer Response contributes to the calling of Medical Teams by implementing response activities which include case management, psychosocial support, safe space activity, and another related project. The position holder will train and supervise social workers and community activists in Refugee camps & host Communities to prevent and respond to GBV issues. This includes providing ongoing training and mentorship for community workers, and community activists, developing a weekly, monthly, and quarterly work plan, and utilizing monitoring and evaluation systems to ensure high-quality services, smooth communication, collaboration, and coordination among partners from the protection, health, legal, and psychosocial sectors committed to reducing the incidence of violence against women. ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES Prepare and develop weekly and monthly work plans for GBV-related prevention activities, ensuring alignment with the overall program objectives. Implement GBV prevention and response activities, including fieldwork and community-based programs, ensuring that activities are in line with GBV IASC guidelines and best practices. Process and maintain accurate case documentation, including case histories, assessments, interventions, and progress reports, ensuring all information complies with confidentiality standards. Apply protection principles such as confidentiality, safety, and non-discrimination in all program activities, ensuring that GBV survivors are treated with respect and dignity. Prepare outreach materials and awareness campaigns tailored to local communities, ensuring that the information is relevant and culturally appropriate. Implement community-based interventions in partnership with relevant stakeholders such as women and children’s affairs, teachers, medical providers, and law enforcement. Process referrals to appropriate service providers for GBV survivors, ensuring that their needs are met, and all required documentation is provided. We envision a country in which women and girls have equal opportunity, claim their rights and free from any violence, and become effective social change agents.

Mission

Our mission is to empower Ethiopian women, girls, and youth in economic, political, and social dimensions, and help them unlock their potential in decision-making through capacity building, advocacy, leadership development, and humanitarian intervention programs.

Core Values and Belief

The Protection Officer is responsible for the planning, coordination, implementation, monitoring, and reporting of protection activities at woreda level. The Officer will lead the implementation of community-based protection interventions, strengthen community protection committees, facilitate consultations on child and early marriage, support the implementation of community action plans, and oversee the rehabilitation and functioning of the existing Women and Girls Safe Space (WGSS), where applicable.

The Protection Officer will work closely with the Social Worker, community structures, religious leaders, local authorities, and relevant service providers to ensure that protection activities are inclusive, community-led, safe, accountable, and consistent with protection, safeguarding, PSEA, child protection, gender, disability inclusion, and Do No Harm principles.

  • Promote community-led identification and prioritization of protection concerns and solutions.
  • Strengthen collaboration between community structures and formal protection and social service systems.

  • Facilitate dialogue and collaboration among communities, leaders, authorities, and service providers.
  • Promote positive social and behavioral change related to protection, safety, dignity, and rights.
  • Support communities to develop and implement locally owned solutions to identified protection concerns.
  • Ensure community engagement approaches are conflict-sensitive, inclusive, and culturally appropriate.

  • Provide technical oversight to ensure the existing WGSS is safe, accessible, functional, and responsive to the needs of women and girls.

fields.title: Filler and Crowner Machine Operator
fields.description: Position Title: Filler & Crown Machine Operator s Job Purpose To operate, monitor, and control the filler and crown machine safely and efficiently to ensure the continuous production of quality beverages. The position is responsible for proper machine operation, adjustment, basic troubleshooting, cleaning, and routine inspection while maintaining product quality, production efficiency, food safety, and workplace safety standards. Key Duties and Responsibilities Operate and monitor the filler and crown machine in accordance with approved operating procedures and production schedules. Set up, adjust, and operate filling and crown/capping equipment to achieve required production output and quality standards. Monitor filling volume, crown/cap application, bottle condition, sealing performance, and other critical operating parameters. Conduct routine inspections of the machine and identify abnormal operating conditions, defects, leaks, unusual noises, or other malfunctions. Perform basic machine adjustments and troubleshooting to minimize downtime and maintain smooth production. Ensure proper synchronization of the filler, crown machine, conveyor, and associated production equipment. Check the availability and proper supply of bottles, crowns/caps, beverages, CO₂, compressed air, water, and other required inputs as applicable. Maintain accurate records of production output, machine stoppages, downtime, defects, wastage, and other operational data. Report machine breakdowns, quality deviations, safety hazards, and abnormal conditions promptly to the responsible supervisor or maintenance team. Work closely with maintenance personnel during preventive maintenance, corrective maintenance, machine inspection, and breakdown recovery. Carry out routine cleaning, sanitation, lubrication, and operator-level maintenance activities as specified in standard operating procedures. Maintain good housekeeping around the machine and production area in accordance with 5S/GMP requirements. Ensure compliance with food safety, quality, occupational health and safety, environmental, and company requirements. Identify and remove defective bottles, improperly crowned/capped bottles, under-filled or over-filled products, and other non-conforming products. Monitor machine performance and contribute to improving production efficiency, line utilization, OEE, and reduction of material and product losses. Follow approved procedures for start-up, operation, changeover, shutdown, and emergency stopping of the equipment. Ensure that machine guards and safety devices are properly installed and functional before and during operation. Immediately stop the machine and report unsafe conditions that may cause injury, equipment damage, or product contamination. Participate in machine changeovers and adjustments according to the production plan. Follow all work instructions, standard operating procedures, GMP, HACCP/food safety, and other applicable management-system requirements. Participate in continuous improvement activities aimed at reducing downtime, waste, defects, and operational costs. Perform other related duties assigned by the immediate supervisor.

fields.title: Purchase Executive- Contract
fields.description: The Purchase Executive – Contracts is responsible for managing all supplier contracts and agreements within the Supply Chain Department. The role ensures that all procurement transactions are governed by valid, compliant, and up-to-date contracts that safeguard the company’s interests. The position involves preparing, reviewing, and maintaining supplier contracts, coordinating with legal and finance departments, and monitoring supplier compliance with contractual terms and performance standards. Contract Preparation and Administration Draft, review, and finalize supplier and service contracts in coordination with the Deputy Manager – SCM and Legal Department. Ensure all contracts reflect accurate commercial terms, scope of work, and delivery obligations. Maintain a centralized contract management system with proper indexing and retrieval. Monitor contract validity periods, renewal dates, and termination clauses. Coordinate with suppliers to ensure timely renewal or closure of expiring contracts. Compliance and Risk Management Ensure all procurement and service contracts comply with company policies, legal requirements, and internal controls. Verify supplier documentation including licenses, tax compliance, and registration certificates. Monitor and enforce compliance with terms on pricing, quality, delivery timelines, and confidentiality. Identify potential contractual risks and escalate issues to management for mitigation. Supplier Coordination and Performance Tracking Act as the primary liaison between SCM and suppliers regarding contractual issues and clarifications. Support vendor evaluation processes by tracking contract compliance and performance metrics. Maintain communication logs and correspondence related to supplier agreements. Participate in contract negotiation sessions to ensure fair and transparent dealings. Documentation and Record Keeping Maintain accurate and complete contract files including correspondence, addendums, and performance records. Ensure all contract-related documents are properly stored and easily accessible for audits. Support Finance and Legal teams with relevant documentation for supplier payments and dispute resolution. Track and update supplier details and contract data in the ERP system. Reporting and Support Functions Prepare periodic reports on active contracts, expiries, renewals, and supplier compliance status. Provide input for management decision-making on supplier retention, renewal, or termination. Support internal and external audits related to procurement contracts. Collaborate with the Legal and Compliance departments to align contract templates with company policy.

fields.title: CCTV System Supply and Installation ToR for Digital Horizon Project partner Schools
fields.description: Introduction and Background SOS Children’s Villages in Ethiopia, a member association of SOS Children’s Villages International, was established in response to the 1973 famine. Since its inception, the organization has been committed to supporting children who have lost parental care or are at risk of losing it through childcare, protection, family strengthening, education, and health services. In addition, SOS Children’s Villages in Ethiopia provides humanitarian assistance to communities affected by conflict, drought, and other emergencies, with a particular focus on vulnerable women and children. The organization currently operates across eight regional states, namely Tigray, Addis Ababa, Amhara, Harari, Oromia, Sidama, South Ethiopia, Southwest Ethiopia, and Somali. As part of its commitment to improving educational quality and promoting digital transformation in schools, SOS Children’s Villages in Ethiopia is implementing the Digital Horizon (DH) Project in the Tigray Region. The project aims to strengthen teaching, learning, and school administration through the integration of digital technologies in selected schools. By expanding access to ICT infrastructure, digital learning resources, and data-driven management practices, the initiative seeks to create a modern, inclusive, and technology-enabled educational environment. To support this goal, digital centers and classrooms are being established to provide students and teachers with access to modern computing facilities, internet connectivity, and innovative digital tools that enhance learning outcomes and foster digital literacy. A key component of this initiative is the establishment of digital centers within targeted schools. These centers aim to provide students and teachers with access to modern ICT infrastructure, digital learning tools, and internet-enabled educational resources. To ensure the safety and security of these digital centers, the implementation of a CCTV surveillance system is a critical component of the project. Therefore, the primary objective of this document is to define the requirements and scope for securing the digital centers in the targeted schools through the design, installation, and operation of an effective surveillance system. Objective s The overall objective is to design, supply, installation and maintenance of a CCTV surveillance system. This system will be deployed to secure the digital centers in targeted schools, ensuring the protection of ICT infrastructure, safeguarding students and staff, and supporting the continuity of digital learning initiatives. Scope of Work shops The supplier has the following scopes, but is not limited to the following tasks: The installation of the CCTV surveillance system will be carried out in selected digital centers across targeted schools in Tigray. The coverage is limited to digital rooms only and does not extend to the entire school premises. The specific locations and number of schools are Mekelle: 3 schools, Kola -Temben: 1 school, Samre: 2 schools, Adwa: 1 school, and Axum: 4 schools. raw_data.description:
Introduction and Background      

SOS Children’s Villages in Ethiopia, a member association of SOS Children’s Villages International, was established in response to the 1973 famine. Since its inception, the organization has been committed to supporting children who have lost parental care or are at risk of losing it through childcare, protection, family strengthening, education, and health services. In addition, SOS Children’s Villages in Ethiopia provides humanitarian assistance to communities affected by conflict, drought, and other emergencies, with a particular focus on vulnerable women and children. The organization currently operates across eight regional states, namely Tigray, Addis Ababa, Amhara, Harari, Oromia, Sidama, South Ethiopia, Southwest Ethiopia, and Somali.

As part of its commitment to improving educational quality and promoting digital transformation in schools, SOS Children’s Villages in Ethiopia is implementing the Digital Horizon (DH) Project in the Tigray Region. The project aims to strengthen teaching, learning, and school administration through the integration of digital technologies in selected schools. By expanding access to ICT infrastructure, digital learning resources, and data-driven management practices, the initiative seeks to create a modern, inclusive, and technology-enabled educational environment. To support this goal, digital centers and classrooms are being established to provide students and teachers with access to modern computing facilities, internet connectivity, and innovative digital tools that enhance learning outcomes and foster digital literacy.

A key component of this initiative is the establishment of digital centers within targeted schools. These centers aim to provide students and teachers with access to modern ICT infrastructure, digital learning tools, and internet-enabled educational resources. To ensure the safety and security of these digital centers, the implementation of a CCTV surveillance system is a critical component of the project. Therefore, the primary objective of this document is to define the requirements and scope for securing the digital centers in the targeted schools through the design, installation, and operation of an effective surveillance system.

Objectives

The overall objective is to design, supply, installation and maintenance of a CCTV surveillance system. This system will be deployed to secure the digital centers in targeted schools, ensuring the protection of ICT infrastructure, safeguarding students and staff, and supporting the continuity of digital learning initiatives.

Scope of Workshops

The supplier has the following scopes, but is not limited to the following tasks:

  • The installation of the CCTV surveillance system will be carried out in selected digital centers across targeted schools in Tigray.
  • The coverage is limited to digital rooms only and does not extend to the entire school premises. The specific locations and number of schools are Mekelle: 3 schools, Kola -Temben: 1 school, Samre: 2 schools, Adwa: 1 school, and Axum: 4 schools.
  • Conduct a detailed survey of each digital center to determine optimal camera placement.
  • Design High level diagram which shows Equipment installation and position of the equipment in each school.
  • Prepare a comprehensive CCTV system design, specifying the number of cameras, type, resolution, storage, and network requirements.
  • Assess the existing LAN and rack suitability for CCTV equipment, or recommend procurement of a new rack, and supply all required hardware.
  • Install and configure the CCTV system according to the approved design, ensuring proper cable management, labeling, and compliance with safety standards.
  • Incorporate cloud or alternative data backup mechanisms in the design and ensure indoor and outdoor cameras support night detection.
  • Integrate the CCTV system with existing ICT infrastructure where applicable, and conduct full functionality testing for live monitoring, recording, playback, and remote access.
  • Provide system calibration and troubleshooting to ensure optimal performance, and train designated project and school staff on operation, maintenance, and basic troubleshooting, supported by user manuals and documentation.
  • Offer a warranty for system components and installation, along with technical support and maintenance services under agreed terms.
